newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-RUSSIA BEAT ISRAEL 2-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RUSSIA BEAT ISRAEL 2-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Russia beat Israel 2-0 (halftime 2-0) in their World Cup European zone group five qualifier on Sunday:

Russia - 1-Sergei Ovchinnikov; 3-Yuri Nikiforov, 6-Akhrik Tsveiba, 7-Viktor Onopko, 4-Alexei Kosolapov; 9-Sergei Grishin (17-Valery Yesipov, 90), 8-Dmitry Alenichev, 2-Vladislav Radimov, 5-Igor Yanovsky; 11-Vladimir Beschastnykh (15-Andrei Tikhonov, 61), 10-Dmitry Cheryshev (13-Yuri Kovtun, 82).

Israel - 1-Rafi Cohen; 2-Felix Halfon, 3-David Amsalem, 4-Alon Hazan, 5-Amir Shelah; 6-Arik Bennado, 7-Ronnie Rosenthal (12-Alon Harazi, 46), 8-Haim Revivo (15-Itzik Zohar, 58), 10-Avi Nimni; 11-Eli Ohana (13-Alon Mizrahi, 73), 9-Eyal Berkowitz.
